description:
Studio with Sea and Pool View, Sky Pool and Private Beach in a Landmark Resort-Style Project

A 36 sqm studio with a sea and pool view, in a landmark resort-style project in Hurghada with a signature sky pool and a private beach. It is priced at 3,350,000 EGP, which puts a unit with hotel-level amenities within reach of buyers who want a holiday home or a rental-income property on the Red Sea.

The studio looks over both the sea and the pools, so you get the water on two sides: the open horizon, and the lively pool areas of the project below.

The sky pool is the project’s standout feature. It spans the gap between two towers, with a glass base that lets you look down into the courtyard below, and swimming there is unlike anything in a typical apartment compound. The towers have a distinctive curved design in brass and gold tones, with sculpted balconies on every level. At the center of the project is a landscaped courtyard with an open-air restaurant area and a water-feature entrance. A large free-form pool has a swim-up bar under a timber pergola, surrounded by sun loungers and paved seating, and there are more pools and planted gardens throughout. Your private beach completes the picture, so the sea is part of daily life as well.

At 36 sqm, the studio has room to live, sleep and entertain in one open space, and it comes with a level of shared facilities that is rare at this price.
